reported_issues: Phone controllers could not operate the title screen.
Player 1 could not reliably aim from the phone.
root_causes: Phone fire/button edges were ignored while the title overlay was open.
Player 1's large shared-screen pointer vector could outrank the normalized phone aim vector.
A fast right-stick release could recenter before polling transported its final direction.

evidence: A on Phone 1 closed the title and started Two Wardens with both phone seats labeled.
X on Phone 1 started a one-warden game.
Y on Phone 1 started a two-warden game.
A resumed a game paused by the phone Menu button.
Reload baselined existing edge counters and did not replay a stale title press.
Pure input regression test proves connected controller aim overrides a -420/180 pointer vector.
A quick P1 right-stick flick changed the live canvas diagnostic from -1.00,0.00 to 1.00,0.00.
Moving the shared-screen pointer hard left afterward left P1 aim at 1.00,0.00.
Aim-release fire now transports a retained fireAimX/fireAimY snapshot instead of relying on live-stick poll timing.

phone_layout.evidence: START / FIRE plus A start, X solo, and Y co-op guidance rendered without overflow.

browser_console.evidence: No warning or error entries on the game, P1 controller, or P2 controller pages.

remaining: Mike and Errol should retest the fixes on their physical phones; disconnect/reconnect QA remains pending.
